entities.description: A character who has offered a thousand pounds to the Restoration Fund and is anxious for the post to bring today's Times.
entities.name: THE DEAN

entities.description: A character who reacts to the Dean's announcement and later reflects on the evening.
entities.name: GEORGIANA

entities.description: A character who is excited to sing, has his music in his overcoat pocket, and later discovers his music roll is empty.
entities.name: TARVER

entities.description: A character who interacts with Tarver and sits beside him.
entities.name: SALOME

entities.description: A character who mentions Darbey's violin and accompanies him on the piano.
entities.name: SHEBA

entities.description: A character who has brought his violin and plays it, accompanied by Sheba.
entities.name: DARBEY

entities.description: A servant who removes the tea-tray and brings the violin-case and music roll.
entities.name: BLORE

entities.description: A fund to which the Dean has offered a thousand pounds.
entities.name: Restoration Fund

entities.description: A newspaper that the Dean is anxious to receive.
entities.name: Times

entities.description: A violinist whose bowing Darbey's mother compares to Darbey's.
entities.name: Joachim

relations.description: The Dean has offered a thousand pounds to the Restoration Fund.
relations.evidence_quote: I've offered a thousand pounds to our Restoration Fund.

relations.description: The Dean is anxious for the post to bring today's Times.
relations.evidence_quote: I'm rather anxious for the post to bring to-day's "Times."

relations.description: Tarver speaks to Salome about his excitement and later sits beside her.
relations.evidence_quote: TARVER. [_Jumping up excitedly--to SALOME._] Eh? Oh, certainly--delighted!

relations.description: Darbey asks Sheba to accompany him and she does.
relations.evidence_quote: DARBEY. [_Tuning his violin._] Will you accompany me? SHEBA. [_Raising her eyes._] To the end of the world.

relations.description: Darbey's mother compares his bowing to Joachim's.
relations.evidence_quote: My mother says that my bowing is something like Joachim's, and she ought to know.
